_comment: The bosses' definitions (Nat, 25 Oct: "other than the dragon priest we should develop other bosses people could grind for special drops/schematics"; design _work/boss-roster-design-1025.md on the PC). Read by tools/bosses/bosses_build.py, which resolves every editor id and desc against the load order, picks each spot's anchor and writes bosses.json for bosses.js. spots: candidates, the first is used; a boss with enabled false waits on Nat (his eye on the spot, or an item still being built). bossEdid / addEdids: NPC_ or LVLN editor ids. drops: always [[desc, count]], shards { desc, count, top } (an item made for this boss, filled in once it exists), schematic { family, chance } (smithing.json family; a smith who knows it gets knownBonus of the shards instead), extra [[desc, chance, count]]. waves: at a share of the boss's health, n adds of addEdids. Seconds throughout.
